text: Search functions automatically iterate RIS pages return results scope. Returned tibbles include: - pagination columns: page, per_page - content_urls - app_metadata
code: library(risAT)  # Search all Judikatur applications via a single english API results_bvwg <- ris_search_case_law(   application = "federal_administrative_court",   query = "Asyl",   per_page = 20 )  # Convenience wrapper: Administrative Court (VwGH) results_vwgh <- ris_search_vwgh(   query = "Baurecht",   per_page = 10 )  # Convenience wrapper: Verfassungsgerichtshof (VfGH) # Defaults to Rechtssätze (RS). Set `search_decision_text = TRUE` # to include Entscheidungstexte (TE). results_vfgh <- ris_search_vfgh(   query = "Grundrecht",   per_page = 10 )  # VfGH aliases (english) for decision_type, sort_by, and in_ris_since results_vfgh_recent <- ris_search_vfgh(   decision_type = "judgment",   sort_by = "decision_date",   sort_direction = "descending",   in_ris_since = "one_week",   per_page = 10 )

title: Search Austrian Case Law in RIS — ris_search_case_law
text: application Judikatur application. Accepts RIS codes ("Vfgh", "Vwgh", "Normenliste", "Justiz", "Bvwg", "Lvwg", "Dsk", "Dok", "Pvak", "Gbk", "Uvs", "AsylGH", "Ubas", "Umse", "Bks", "Verg") English aliases (example "constitutional_court", "administrative_court", "justice", "federal_administrative_court", "state_administrative_courts"). query Optional full-text query (Suchworte). business_number Optional business number (Geschaeftszahl). norm Optional legal norm query (Norm). decision_date_from Optional lower date bound (YYYY-MM-DD, EntscheidungsdatumVon). decision_date_to Optional upper date bound (YYYY-MM-DD, EntscheidungsdatumBis). decision_type Optional decision type (Entscheidungsart). VfGH, accepted values "Undefined", "Beschluss", "Erkenntnis", "Vergleich", "KeineAngabe" aliases "order", "judgment", "settlement", "not_specified". index_term Optional index term (Index). collection_number Optional collection number (Sammlungsnummer). title Optional title (Titel), used Normenliste. document_kind Optional document kind (Typ), used Normenliste. publication_organ Optional publication organ (Kundmachungsorgan), used Normenliste. legal_area Optional legal area (Rechtsgebiet), used Justiz. specialist_area Optional specialist area (Fachgebiet), used Justiz. court Optional court (Gericht), used Justiz. legal_principle_number Optional legal principle number (Rechtssatznummer), used Justiz. legal_assessment Optional legal assessment (RechtlicheBeurteilung), used Justiz. ruling Optional ruling text (Spruch), used Justiz Ubas. citation Optional citation (Fundstelle), used Justiz. changed_since_period Optional change window (AenderungenSeitPeriode), used Justiz. federal_state Optional federal state (Bundesland), used Lvwg Uvs. deciding_authority Optional deciding authority (EntscheidendeBehoerde), used Dsk, Dok, Pvak, Verg. commission Optional commission (Kommission), used Gbk. senate Optional senate (Senat), used Gbk. discrimination_ground Optional discrimination ground (Diskriminierungsgrund), used Gbk. author Optional author (Verfasser), used Ubas. short_title Optional short title (Kurzbezeichnung), used Umse. domain Optional domain (Bereich), used Bks. in_ris_since Optional RIS recency filter (ImRisSeit). Accepts API values ("Undefined", "EinerWoche", "ZweiWochen", "EinemMonat", "DreiMonaten", "SechsMonaten", "EinemJahr") English aliases ("one_week", "two_weeks", "one_month", "three_months", "six_months", "one_year"). sort_by Optional sort column (SortierungSortedByColumn). VfGH, accepted values "Geschaeftszahl", "Datum", "Art", "Typ" aliases "business_number", "decision_date", "decision_type", "document_type". sort_direction Optional sort direction (SortierungSortDirection), one "Ascending" "Descending" (case-insensitive). search_decision_text Optional flag decision text search (SucheInEntscheidungstexten). search_legal_principles Optional flag legal principles search (SucheInRechtssaetzen). page Legacy argument kept backward compatibility. Search functions now always iterate pages page 1. per_page Results per page. Allowed values: 10, 20, 50, 100 (mapped DokumenteProSeite values Ten, Twenty, Fifty, OneHundred). base_url API base URL.
